basic_info.description: Completely reimagined by a renowned interior designer, unit 601 is a stunning condominium in the heart of the bustling Japantown and Lower Pacific Heights neighborhoods. Designed by Joseph Eichler's office, 66 Cleary Court showcases mid-century modern elements that emphasize natural light, surrounding views and modern layouts. Situated on the south-side of the building the unit is incomparable for convenience, privacy and solitude. With porcelain floors, raked wall tiles, custom cabinetry, Fleetwood windows with lux curtains and solar shades #601 is rumored to be the best unit in the building. The home also features in-unit laundry, an open kitchen with Bosch and Thermador appliances, private balcony and an atypical layout allowing the third bedroom to be a private home office, gym or lounge. Additionally, an oversized pocket door allows the guest room to be open to the living room for a more expansive living experience. The building has recently undergone a major update and is serviced by an active HOA and 24 hour doorman. Amenities include outdoor gardens, a shared sports court and 1 car parking.
